scope.purpose: Local 2D feasibility spike, not regulatory submission or clinical inference
scope.standards_reference: SDTMIG 3.3 / SDTM 1.7, deliberately pinned reference, not a claim of latest version or full conformance
scope.suppqual_convention: SUPPQUAL is the model/category; this package uses the domain-specific SUPPAE dataset, not a submitted pooled SUPPQUAL dataset

snapshot.digest_scope: Exact fixtures.json file bytes, including roster and synthetic relationship documentation
snapshot.seed_semantics: Reserved deterministic generator seed for downstream implementation; these are hand-authored golden inputs, not output of a random generator

count-v1.qualifying_patient_count: Cardinality of distinct patient keys with at least one qualifying AE record
count-v1.qualifying_ae_record_count: Cardinality of qualifying AE source record IDs, deduplicated before any relationship expansion
count-v1.clinical_episode_count: Not computed; AE-record count must not be relabeled as unique clinical episodes
count-v1.denominator: Explicit roster population before the AE qualification predicate; never visible lanes or joined row count
count-v1.empty_qualifications: Return zero counts only for a fully specified executable query with no matches; clarification-required requests have null result, not zero

relrec-v1.numeric_selector_comparison: For --SEQ only, compare IDVARVAL to the decimal integer representation of the numeric source value; do not coerce arbitrary IDs or trim/rewrite raw tokens
relrec-v1.group_endpoint: Retain one logical endpoint with the raw selector and all matching source-record IDs; never select only the first match
relrec-v1.blank_reltype: Preserve empty string exactly. Accept for subject-record relationships. Do not fill ONE/MANY, infer hierarchy, or drop association
relrec-v1.observed_cardinality: Number of resolved records per endpoint is observed data, not a replacement for RELTYPE
relrec-v1.meaning: RELREC establishes association. Clinical meaning/direction needs separately cited documentation; absence remains unknown. RELTYPE is not clinical semantics
relrec-v1.representation: Keep relationship as an endpoint set/hyperedge; pairwise drawing is a projection, not extra evidence or extra AE records
relrec-v1.zero_matches: Keep selector and evidence, mark unresolved, expose diagnostic; never silently discard
relrec-v1.dataset_scope: Blank USUBJID or blank IDVARVAL is unsupported in v1; retain raw rows and return unsupported_scope, never join all patients

supp-v1.behavior: SUPPAE augments its parent AE; it is neither an AE record nor a RELREC relationship. Preserve QVAL, QORIG and QEVAL. Never require RELREC to attach it

time-v1.supported_resolution: Complete ISO calendar dates YYYY-MM-DD only; no timezone arithmetic or SDTM --DY subtraction
time-v1.clarification_trigger: Any required temporal parameter omitted or unresolved
time-v1.clarification_behavior: status=clarification_required; normalized_analysis_state=null; result=null; ask explicit questions before execution
time-v1.date_delta: event calendar date minus first complete EXSTDTC for the same study and patient

view-v1.invariant: View-only changes never alter qualifying patient or AE-record counts, population, or analysis signature
view-v1.analytical_filter: Changing population, AE predicate, or temporal window changes analysis state and recomputes counts
view-v1.stable_sort: Patient-key lexicographic tie-break; no index-based identity
view-v1.mark_identity: mark:<snapshot_id>:<record_id> for a single-record mark; aggregated marks need a stable ID and all contributing source-record IDs
view-v1.picking: Picking maps stable mark IDs to source-record IDs, not screen position or current row index
view-v1.selection_policy: Hidden/focused-away marks retain logical selection but are not rendered/pickable. If an analytical change removes the selected record from eligible marks, clear selection with reason analysis_excluded; never retarget

provenance-v1.row_number: 1-based original row in the named snapshot dataset, not the sorted display row
provenance-v1.identity_stability: Record IDs are immutable within the pinned snapshot; external identity is snapshot_id plus record_id
provenance-v1.mark_evidence: Each mark carries all contributing source-record refs and the derivation rule ID; relationship marks also retain RELREC row refs and any semantics-document ref
provenance-v1.raw_values: Provenance lookup returns the original values, including blanks; derived facts are stored separately

replay-v1.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=true, sorted object keys, compact separators comma and colon, no trailing newline, no NaN/Infinity; ordered arrays remain ordered
replay-v1.normalization: Require every schema field explicitly, including null for an unused window or selection; reject unknown fields, missing fields and duplicate population keys, hidden lanes or focus keys; sort those unordered arrays lexicographically; preserve patient_sort priority order. Normalization does not fill defaults or repair duplicates.
replay-v1.rule_bundle_digest: sha256 of canonical JSON of the rule_bundle object in contract.json
replay-v1.analysis_signature: sha256 of canonical JSON of contract_version, snapshot_id, snapshot_sha256, rule_bundle_id, rule_bundle_version, rule_bundle_sha256, and analysis_state; view_state excluded
replay-v1.exact_restoration: Export, import, and export normalized spec; canonical bytes and all pins must match
replay-v1.analysis_reproduction: Same pins and normalized analysis produce identical ordered qualified patient keys, AE record IDs, counts and exclusion diagnostics; not merely visually similar
replay-v1.pin_mismatch: Fail closed with snapshot_mismatch or rule_bundle_mismatch; never silently fall forward to newest data or rules

acceptance.require: Separate patient and AE-record counts and label units
Preserve group selector and full scoped membership; joins cannot multiply counts
Association displayed with clinical meaning unknown
Clarification, no executable state or counts
Exact spec restore, reproduced analysis, invariant counts under view changes, stable picking and selection clearing
Supplement resolves to parent without creating events

review_independence: Authored and self-checked by GPT Sol in this task; expected values are stated separately from the checker but not independently authored by another reviewer
